papers.title: Perceptive Humanoid Motion from Simulation
papers.abstract: Humanoid robots have the potential to automate a wide range of physical tasks. Progress toward generalist humanoid autonomy, however, remains constrained by a data bottleneck: mapping pixels and free-form language to low-level joint commands requires paired supervision, and no corpus of such data exists at sufficiently large scale. Some approaches rely on human teleoperation and wearable capture devices, which require at least an hour of human time to produce an hour of data. We present HALO, a humanoid autonomy system powered by a pipeline that synthesizes vision-language-motion data across a thousand procedurally generated homes. The corpus scales with compute rather than human labor. HALO acquires a repertoire of physical skills, including sitting on chairs, navigating to named objects, stepping sideways through half-open doors, crouching and crawling beneath tables, and pushing boxes. It orchestrates these skills to solve composite, long-horizon tasks. Without ever seeing a real home during training, HALO transfers zero-shot to the physical world, achieving a 91% success rate across 360 trials in six unmapped real-world environments. See https://apple-aiml-research.github.io/ml-halo/ for code and videos.

ai_summary.problem: 人形机器人要实现通用自主性，但缺乏大规模“像素+语言到低层关节指令”的配对数据，现有遥操作/穿戴采集成本高、规模受限。
ai_summary.method: 论文提出 HALO 系统，在1000个程序化生成的虚拟家庭中合成视觉-语言-运动数据，使数据规模随算力扩展而非人力；系统学习坐椅子、导航到指定物体、侧身过半开门、蹲爬桌下、推箱子等技能，并组合完成长时程任务。
ai_summary.result: HALO 训练中从未见过真实家庭，却能零样本迁移到真实世界，在6个未建图真实环境中完成360次试验，达到91%成功率。
ai_summary.novelty: 核心创新是用大规模程序化仿真自动合成人形机器人视觉-语言-运动数据，并以零样本方式迁移到真实世界。
ai_summary.relevance: 该工作展示了以仿真数据规模化替代昂贵人类遥操作采集的可行路径，对人形机器人、具身智能和通用机器人策略学习具有重要意义。
ai_summary.org: Apple（Apple AIML Research）

papers.title: Visual Token Routing: Learning to keep tokens that matter
papers.abstract: Computer-use agents (CUAs) have recently achieved superhuman performance on several long-horizon benchmarks. However, their computational cost limits their use in long-horizon tasks and real-time domains such as video games. A key bottleneck is representing each screenshot as thousands of visual tokens, which accumulate into long contexts as agents reason over extended interaction histories. We observe that most of these visual tokens are either semantically irrelevant to the agent's next action or temporally redundant across screenshots. Building on this observation, we introduce Visual Token Routing (VTR), a joint training framework for learning sparse visual representations that preserve the information needed for action prediction. In VTR, we train the vision-language model together with a lightweight spatio-temporal router that examines each image region in the current and previous screenshots and decides whether its visual token enters the language model. We optimize the router using an adaptive loss to keep the number of visual tokens as small as possible while minimizing performance degradation. With just 2,000 training steps, VTR matches the performance of the full-resolution model on OSWorld, CUA-World, and video game action prediction, while using 2.5-5.8x fewer visual tokens. These savings reduce inference cost by up to 3.3x and speed up prefill by up to 2.9x. VTR also outperforms lowering the image resolution and other baselines for dropping tokens, by up to 12.8 points on OSWorld. Overall, VTR enables computer-use agents to process only the visual tokens they need, allowing them to be used in long-horizon tasks and real-time domains at a fraction of the computational cost. Code and models are available at https://pranjal2041.github.io/vtr

ai_summary.problem: 计算机使用智能体（CUA）需要处理大量截图视觉 token，导致上下文过长和计算成本过高，限制了其在长程任务和实时场景（如视频游戏）中的应用。
ai_summary.method: 论文提出 Visual Token Routing（VTR），联合训练视觉语言模型与轻量级时空路由器；路由器检查当前及前一截图中的每个图像区域，决定其视觉 token 是否进入语言模型，并用自适应损失在尽量少用 token 与保持性能之间权衡。
ai_summary.result: 仅训练 2000 步，VTR 在 OSWorld、CUA-World 和视频游戏动作预测上匹配全分辨率模型性能，同时减少 2.5-5.8 倍视觉 token，推理成本最多降低 3.3 倍、prefill 最多加速 2.9 倍；在 OSWorld 上比降低分辨率和其他丢 token 基线最高高 12.8 分。
ai_summary.novelty: 核心创新是面向计算机使用智能体的时空视觉 token 路由机制，通过联合训练学习稀疏视觉表示，只保留对下一步动作有用的视觉信息。
ai_summary.relevance: 该方法显著降低多模态智能体的视觉 token 计算成本，有助于推动长程任务和实时交互场景中的计算机使用智能体落地。
ai_summary.org: Carnegie Mellon University (CMU)

papers.title: EvoWorld: Towards Out-of-Sight World Evolution in Generative Video Models
papers.abstract: Generative video models are increasingly used as visual world simulators, yet their primary strength lies in rendering plausible pixels rather than reasoning about how a world should evolve. Coherent world evolution requires more than visual fidelity: when an event occurs, a model must infer its consequences for the entities in the world and then render the resulting state. For example, after a wild beast appears, the model should not only depict the wild beast, but also infer whether a nearby person should flee, take cover, or fight back based on the realized scene. Existing diffusion-based video models lack an explicit mechanism for maintaining world state and reasoning over such event-conditioned consequences, often producing visually plausible but behaviorally static or causally inconsistent outputs. To make this reasoning gap concrete and measurable, we propose a new problem, Out-of-Sight Causal Evolution, which requires a model to render an event, reason about its consequences for the evolving world state, and reveal a causally plausible outcome as the world continues to evolve, even out of sight. As a baseline reference solution, we introduce EvoWorld, a brain-renderer collaboration framework in which a vision-language model serves as the world brain: it observes generated segments, maintains an evolving account of the world, and reasons about plausible state transitions, while a segment-autoregressive video renderer realizes them visually. We further introduce EvoWorld-Data and EvoWorld-Bench for training and evaluating event realization, causal reactions, and revisit consistency. Experiments show that EvoWorld substantially improves event-conditioned causal evolution over recent models while preserving visual quality and consistency, establishing a reference point for reasoning-guided, autonomous world evolution beyond the current field of view.

ai_summary.problem: 现有扩散式视频生成模型只擅长渲染逼真的像素，缺乏显式的世界状态维护与因果推理机制，当事件发生时无法推断其后果（如野兽出现后人该逃跑还是反击），常生成视觉合理但行为静态或因果不一致的视频。论文将这一问题形式化为“视野外因果演化”（Out-of-Sight Causal Evolution）任务。
ai_summary.method: 提出 EvoWorld 框架，采用“大脑-渲染器”协作架构：以视觉语言模型作为世界大脑，观察已生成的视频片段、维护不断更新的世界状态描述，并推理事件导致的合理状态转移；再由片段自回归的视频渲染器将这些状态在视觉上实现。同时构建 EvoWorld-Data 训练数据与 EvoWorld-Bench 评测基准，覆盖事件呈现、因果反应与重访一致性三类指标。
ai_summary.result: 实验表明 EvoWorld 在保持视觉质量与时空一致性的同时，显著优于近期模型的事件条件因果演化能力，为超越当前视野的推理引导式自主世界演化提供了参考基线。
ai_summary.novelty: 首次提出并形式化“视野外因果演化”问题，并用 VLM 世界大脑 + 自回归视频渲染器的解耦协作架构把世界状态推理与像素渲染分离。
ai_summary.relevance: 为生成式视频模型从“像素模拟器”迈向具备因果推理能力的世界模型提供了新任务定义、数据与评测基准，对世界模型与具身智能的想象推演具有推动作用。

papers.title: Traffic-VL: Reinforced Vision-Language Models for Generalizable End-to-End Traffic Signal Control
papers.abstract: Existing traffic signal control methods typically rely on structured traffic states produced by dedicated perception pipelines. Emerging visual approaches often use idealized simulator images and convert them into intermediate representations before control, limiting their ability to directly exploit roadside visual observations. To bridge both the visual-domain and perception-to-decision gaps, we introduce SynTra-V and Traffic-VL. SynTra-V converts physics-based traffic simulations into photorealistic multi-view surveillance imagery across diverse road topologies and sensing conditions, and automatic semantic auditing checks that control-critical geometry, vehicle movements, and lane semantics match the simulator state. Traffic-VL is an eight-billion-parameter vision-language model that directly maps synchronized multi-view images and natural-language phase descriptions to signal decisions without intermediate structured states. Building on Traffic-R1's two-stage reinforced reasoning framework, Traffic-VL adapts its vision encoder via offline reinforcement learning on SynTra-V and freezes it during online visual stepwise trajectory policy optimization in closed-loop simulation. Experiments show that Traffic-VL matches structured-state Traffic-R1 while outperforming image-based controllers and general-purpose vision-language models, including Gemini 3 Pro. Evaluations on unseen topologies, degraded sensing conditions, real surveillance footage, and a three-week deployment across ten intersections further demonstrate robust visual generalization and effective constrained online control.

ai_summary.problem: 现有交通信号控制方法依赖专用感知流程生成的结构化交通状态，或使用理想化仿真图像并转为中间表示，难以直接利用真实路侧视觉观测，存在视觉域与感知到决策的鸿沟。
ai_summary.method: 论文提出 SynTra-V，将物理仿真转换为逼真多视角监控图像并进行自动语义审计；提出 8B 参数视觉语言模型 Traffic-VL，直接将同步多视角图像和自然语言相位描述映射为信号决策。方法基于 Traffic-R1 的两阶段强化推理框架，先在 SynTra-V 上离线强化学习适配视觉编码器，再在闭环仿真中冻结视觉编码器进行在线视觉逐步轨迹策略优化。
ai_summary.result: Traffic-VL 达到结构化状态 Traffic-R1 的水平，并优于基于图像的控制器和通用视觉语言模型（包括 Gemini 3 Pro）；在未见拓扑、退化感知条件、真实监控视频以及十个路口三周部署中表现出稳健的视觉泛化和受限在线控制效果。
ai_summary.novelty: 构建高保真多视角交通视觉数据与语义审计流程，并训练端到端强化视觉语言模型直接由路侧视觉观测和语言相位描述进行交通信号决策。
ai_summary.relevance: 展示了视觉语言模型在真实世界闭环决策与具身/城市智能系统中的潜力，推动了从感知到决策的端到端多模态控制研究。
ai_summary.org: 未提供（作者机构信息为空）

papers.title: From Pixels to Actions - Towards Native Vision-Language-Action Policies
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action models are typically built on a simple premise: perception is first compressed by visual encoders, and action reasoning begins only afterwards. Yet manipulation often hinges on precisely the visual signals most vulnerable to this abstraction, e.g., local geometry, boundaries, depth, and subtle state changes. This raises a fundamental question: should action policies inherit a fixed visual endpoint, or directly access evolving visual computation? We introduce NEO-VLA, a structurally encoder-free vision-language-action framework. Images are tokenized by lightweight patch convolutional layers and evolve jointly with language throughout the backbone, allowing a flow-matching action expert to draw from instruction-conditioned visual representations at different depths. This simple change reveals a consistent pattern. Native architectures outperform encoder-based counterparts under controlled comparisons; full fine-tuning reduces but does not erase the gap, and additional scale alone cannot recover it. More strikingly, layer-wise probing shows that the action-critical signals often peak well before the final visual representation. Across diverse manipulation settings and distribution shifts, NEO-VLA consequently achieves stronger and more robust control. Together, these results suggest that embodied control benefits from access to visual representations across the computational hierarchy, rather than a fixed encoder output.

ai_summary.problem: 现有视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）普遍先用固定视觉编码器把感知压缩成单一视觉表示，再开始动作推理，这会丢失对操作至关重要的局部几何、边界、深度和细微状态变化等信号。论文追问：动作策略应继承固定的视觉终点，还是应直接访问不断演化的视觉计算？
ai_summary.method: 提出 NEO-VLA，一种结构上无编码器（encoder-free）的 VLA 框架：图像经轻量 patch 卷积层直接 token 化，并与语言 token 在主干网络中联合演化；一个 flow-matching 动作专家可从不同深度的、受指令条件化的视觉表示中提取信息来生成动作。
ai_summary.result: 在受控对比下，原生（无编码器）架构一致优于基于编码器的对应方案；全量微调只能缩小而不能消除差距，单纯扩大规模也无法弥补。逐层探针显示，动作关键信号常在最终视觉表示之前就已达到峰值。在多种操作场景与分布偏移下，NEO-VLA 取得更强、更鲁棒的控制性能。
ai_summary.novelty: 打破“先编码再推理”的固定视觉瓶颈，让动作策略直接读取主干中多层、动态演化的视觉计算，并用逐层探针实证动作关键信息并不在最后一层。
ai_summary.relevance: 为具身智能与 VLA 模型的结构设计提供了新范式：视觉表示不应是固定端点，而应是可供下游动作按需取用的层级计算资源，对多模态大模型与机器人策略架构均有启示。
ai_summary.org: 所给信息未提供作者机构（作者名单与新加坡国立大学 ShowLab 等团队常见作者重合，推测相关，但无法确认）

papers.title: BEAKER: An Expert-Curated Benchmark for Embodied Brains in Self-Driving Chemical Laboratories
papers.abstract: Self-Driving Chemical Laboratories (SDCLs) are moving chemical experimentation toward embodied automation, where machines must perceive laboratory scenes, reason about experimental states, and act under physical, procedural, and safety constraints. Although Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) are increasingly considered as embodied brains for such systems, existing laboratory benchmarks mainly focus on safety, anomaly detection, or general scientific understanding, leaving their execution-oriented embodied capabilities underexplored. To fill this gap, we introduce BEAKER, a Benchmark for evaluating Embodied Actionability, Knowledge, Experimentation, and Reasoning in SDCLs. BEAKER contains 1,000 expert-curated question-answer samples across 11 image and video task types, covering key judgments required for chemical laboratory execution, including affordance grounding, trajectory planning, equipment, state, and safety recognition, apparatus setup, operation and step reasoning, and temporal procedure reasoning. All questions and annotations are manually created and reviewed by chemistry and embodied Artificial Intelligence (AI) experts, without AI-assisted generation or annotation. We evaluate 28 general-purpose, science-oriented, chemistry-specialized, and embodied MLLMs in an offline, single-turn setting. Results show that current models can follow coarse experimental procedures in videos, but still struggle to ground actions into operable regions and feasible trajectories, to recognize fine-grained laboratory apparatus, states, and safety norms, and to order steps in mid-length procedures. BEAKER thus reveals a clear gap between coarse procedural understanding and the precise, action-grounded perception required for laboratory execution, providing a diagnostic benchmark for future MLLMs in SDCLs.

ai_summary.problem: 现有实验室基准主要关注安全性、异常检测或一般科学理解，未能充分评估多模态大模型作为自驱动化学实验室（SDCLs）具身大脑的执行导向能力，如可操作性区域定位、轨迹规划和精细状态识别。
ai_summary.method: 提出BEAKER基准，包含1000个由化学与具身AI专家人工创建和审核的问答样本，覆盖11种图像和视频任务类型，涉及可供性定位、轨迹规划、设备/状态/安全识别、装置搭建、操作与步骤推理等；在离线单轮设置下评估了28个通用、科学、化学专用及具身MLLM。
ai_summary.result: 各模型能跟随视频中的粗粒度实验流程，但在将动作落实到可操作区域和可行轨迹、识别细粒度实验室设备/状态/安全规范、以及排序中等长度步骤方面仍存在困难，暴露出粗粒度程序理解与精确动作感知之间的明显差距。
ai_summary.novelty: 首个由专家全人工标注、系统评估SDCLs中MLLM执行导向具身能力的诊断性基准，覆盖从感知到动作规划的多个关键维度。
ai_summary.relevance: 为未来面向自驱动实验室和具身智能的MLLM提供了可诊断的评测标准，推动模型从粗粒度科学理解走向可操作的具身执行。
ai_summary.org: 未明确识别（作者未列出所属机构）

papers.title: Motion-guided Contrastive Regularization For Latent World Models
papers.abstract: JEPA-style world models learn action-conditioned latent dynamics without reconstructing observations, but distributional regularization alone does not ensure that their representations preserve information needed for control. We identify static collapse, a failure mode in which the encoder preserves episode-specific static content while suppressing manipulation-relevant state changes. Because static content is temporally predictable yet diverse across episodes, this failure can persist despite regularizers such as SIGReg. A controlled study on OGBench-Cube shows that introducing randomized backgrounds substantially degrades planning performance while leaving the underlying manipulation task unchanged. To address this problem, we propose motion-guided contrastive regularization. Our approach compares predicted latent transitions with transitions to candidate observations from the same episode, reducing the usefulness of static background identity for distinguishing action outcomes. Optical-flow similarities provide soft contrastive targets, allowing candidates with similar motion to receive similar supervision. Combined with latent prediction and SIGReg, our objective encourages representations to preserve within-episode state distinctions and similarities between related transitions. Our method improves planning success over LeWorldModel (LeWM) from 52% to 78% on OGBench-Cube with randomized backgrounds and from 14% to 54% on LIBERO-Object, while maintaining comparable performance on four other visual-control benchmarks.

ai_summary.problem: JEPA 类潜世界模型仅靠分布正则化，无法保证编码保留控制所需信息，会出现静态坍缩：编码器保留每回合特有的静态背景内容，却抑制与操作相关的状态变化，导致在随机背景下规划性能大幅下降。
ai_summary.method: 提出运动引导的对比正则化：将预测的潜在状态转移与同一回合内候选观测的状态转移进行对比，用光流相似度作为软对比目标，使运动相似的候选获得相似的监督；再与潜在预测和 SIGReg 结合，鼓励表示保留回合内的状态区分度以及相关转移之间的相似性。
ai_summary.result: 在 OGBench-Cube 随机背景下，规划成功率从 LeWM 的 52% 提升到 78%；在 LIBERO-Object 上从 14% 提升到 54%；同时在另外四个视觉控制基准上保持相当性能。
ai_summary.novelty: 首次识别并系统分析了潜世界模型中的静态坍缩问题，并用光流引导的软对比正则化，把运动信息注入 JEPA 式世界模型的表示学习。
ai_summary.relevance: 为 JEPA 类世界模型提供了不依赖重建、能增强控制相关表示的正则化手段，有助于提升具身智能和视觉控制任务在视觉干扰下的鲁棒性。
ai_summary.org: 无法从提供的信息中识别（作者未列出所属机构）

papers.title: Where to Connect? Boosting MLLMs via Dynamic Gated Pathways across ALL ViT and LLM Layers
papers.abstract: A central yet under-explored question in Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) is where to connect---how visual information from a hierarchical vision encoder should be wired into the layer-wise semantics of a large language model. Mainstream MLLMs inject a fixed single-layer visual representation into the LLM and treat all LLM layers as a single consumer, ignoring that different layers demand different visual granularities. Recent multi-layer fusion methods either compress hierarchical features on the encoder side or rely on predefined sparse or hierarchical layer-to-layer connections, and therefore stop short of modeling adaptive cross-layer interactions between the ViT and LLM hierarchies. We address this gap with DGP (Dynamic Gated Pathways), a routing mechanism that establishes all-to-all connections between every ViT layer and every LLM layer, with each LLM layer dynamically gating its preference over visual layers conditioned on its own semantic state. Built on top of LLaVA-1.5-7B and 13B, DGP delivers consistent gains over the LLaVA-1.5-7B baseline (e.g., +4.2 on SQA$^{I}$, +3.3 on MM-Vet, +3.1 on VizWiz and LLaVA$^{W}$) and surpasses prior multi-layer visual fusion methods on most benchmarks. Layer-wise routing analyses further show that different LLM layers do select different visual granularities on demand, supporting both the effectiveness and interpretability of the proposed dynamic gated pathways. The code is available: https://github.com/YingyingYan1/DGP.

ai_summary.problem: 多模态大模型中视觉信息应连接到LLM的哪一层尚不清楚；主流方法将固定单层视觉表示注入LLM，忽略了不同LLM层对视觉粒度的差异化需求。
ai_summary.method: 提出DGP（Dynamic Gated Pathways），在每一层ViT与每一层LLM之间建立全连接路由，并让每个LLM层根据自身语义状态动态门控选择偏好的视觉层。方法构建在LLaVA-1.5-7B/13B之上。
ai_summary.result: 在LLaVA-1.5-7B基线上取得稳定提升，如SQA^I +4.2、MM-Vet +3.3、VizWiz和LLaVA^W各+3.1，并在多数基准上超过现有多层视觉融合方法；层间路由分析显示不同LLM层会按需选择不同视觉粒度。
ai_summary.novelty: 用全对全且动态门控的ViT-LLM跨层路由，实现LLM各层对视觉粒度的自适应选择，而非固定单层或预定义稀疏连接。
ai_summary.relevance: 为MLLM中视觉-语言跨层对齐提供了更灵活且可解释的连接范式，对多模态大模型结构设计有参考价值。
ai_summary.org: 未知（作者机构信息未提供）

papers.title: Where Is VLA Inference Time Spent? Bottlenecks and Optimization Interactions Across GPUs
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models map camera observations and language instructions to robot actions. However, their large backbones and repeated action generation can make inference take longer than the robot's real-time requirements for its next action. To reduce the load of VLA computations, researchers have proposed multiple optimization approaches, including quantization and pruning. These optimizations can be combined with other general optimizations such as better kernel compilation or using CUDA graphs instead of the eager mode. However, most of these optimization results are usually reported on a single GPU type, typically for a few VLA models, with no analysis of what the real bottlenecks are for a model on a particular hardware or how these optimizations would generalize beyond the reported results. In this paper, we provide a comprehensive measurement study of seven families of inference optimization methods, from CUDA graphs and compilation to token pruning and quantization, on seven state-of-the-art VLAs evaluated on four GPU families ranging from a datacenter H100 to an embedded Jetson Thor. We analyse how CPU launch overhead, memory bandwidth, and kernel efficiency jointly shape optimization gains, and how applying one method changes the benefit of another. From this analysis, we derive VLA-Triage, guidelines for stacking optimizations under latency budgets. The guidelines identify which stages can provide the required savings and which combinations need testing in the deployed execution mode.

ai_summary.problem: VLA 模型推理延迟常超出机器人实时响应要求，而现有优化（量化、剪枝、编译、CUDA graphs 等）多在单一 GPU 和少数模型上报告，缺乏对真实瓶颈及各优化方法相互作用的系统分析。
ai_summary.method: 在 4 类 GPU（数据中心 H100 到嵌入式 Jetson Thor）上对 7 个先进 VLA 模型开展大规模测量研究，覆盖 7 类推理优化方法（CUDA graphs、编译、token 剪枝、量化等），分析 CPU 启动开销、内存带宽与 kernel 效率如何共同决定优化收益，以及不同优化叠加时的相互影响。
ai_summary.result: 揭示了各硬件-模型组合下的真实性能瓶颈，并据此提出 VLA-Triage 指南，指导在延迟预算下如何选择和叠加优化，指出哪些阶段能提供所需节省、哪些组合必须在实际部署执行模式下验证。
ai_summary.novelty: 首个跨多 GPU 平台、多 VLA 模型、多优化方法的系统性测量与交互作用分析，并给出可操作的优化叠加决策指南。
ai_summary.relevance: 为 VLA 与具身智能模型的实际部署和实时推理优化提供了实证依据与工程指导，弥补了该领域缺乏跨硬件系统评测的空白。

papers.title: Trick-or-Treat: Adversarial Evaluation of Multimodal Medical Reasoning with Synthetic Images
papers.abstract: We used medical image synthesis to create a challenging multimodal evaluation framework that exposes hallucination behaviors in frontier models. Evaluating multimodal reasoning has historically been difficult because existing medical datasets rarely pair different image modalities, such as radiographs and external clinical photographs. To address this gap, we introduce Trick-or-Treat, an adversarial multimodal medical benchmark that pairs real chest radiographs with synthetic clinical photographs to challenge models' cross-modal reasoning. For each of a wide range of conditions, we created two pairs of images, where the pairs share a single chest radiograph but contain different external photographs. In matched pairs, the chest radiograph and photograph both contain findings suggesting the same disease (e.g., varicella pneumonia suggested by lung opacities and crusted skin lesions seen in chickenpox). In mismatched pairs, the photograph depicts an alternative clinical finding that would not lead to the same unifying diagnosis (e.g. replacing crusted skin lesions with ordinary acne). Synthetic photograph generation allows clinical findings to be varied while the person's features and photographic setting stay consistent, reducing confounding. In an investigation of three frontier models, we found that models hallucinated clinically significant photograph findings in 45-57.5% of mismatched pairs, up from 25-37.5% for the same photographs shown alone. When faced with mismatched pairs, models tended to ignore mismatches and instead hallucinated findings that better matched the radiograph (e.g. misreading acne as crusted skin lesions to justify diagnosing chickenpox). Trick-or-Treat both demonstrates concerning error pattern in frontier models' medical reasoning and provides a proof of concept for the use of synthetic images in adversarial multimodal evaluation.

ai_summary.problem: 现有医学多模态评测数据集很少配对不同类型的图像（如胸片与临床照片），难以系统评估模型在跨模态医学推理中的幻觉与不一致处理能力。
ai_summary.method: 作者提出 Trick-or-Treat 对抗性多模态医学基准：为多种疾病构建共享同一张真实胸片、但搭配不同合成临床照片的图像对，分为诊断一致的 matched pairs 和不一致的 mismatched pairs；合成照片可保持人物特征与拍摄场景一致，从而减少混杂因素，并用于评测前沿多模态模型。
ai_summary.result: 在三个前沿模型上，mismatched pairs 中模型对临床照片出现具有临床意义幻觉的比例为 45%–57.5%，高于同一照片单独呈现时的 25%–37.5%；模型倾向于忽略图像间不匹配，并幻觉出更符合胸片的发现来维持统一诊断。
ai_summary.novelty: 利用合成临床照片与真实胸片构造可控的对抗性配对，系统性暴露多模态医学推理中的跨模态幻觉模式。
ai_summary.relevance: 该工作揭示了前沿多模态模型在医学推理中的高风险幻觉行为，并展示了合成图像用于对抗性多模态评测的可行性。

papers.title: MKD2World: A Typed Spatial MarkDown World Model For Web Agents
papers.abstract: Graphical user interface (GUI) agents can improve decision-making with world-model foresight, provided that predicted states accurately reflect post-action interfaces. Existing state representations fail to jointly capture interface layout, UI semantics, and explicit locations. We introduce Typed Spatial Markdown (TSM), a Markdown-style textual state representation for desktop web interfaces. TSM serializes block-level and atomic-level UI elements according to their spatial relationships, jointly encoding their types, visual semantics, explicit locations, optional control states, and hierarchical membership. To train a screenshot-to-TSM renderer, we construct AtomBlock-WebUI, a dataset with precise annotations at both granularities. By injecting element-type labels into HTML and directly extracting bounding boxes after rendering, we avoid annotation errors caused by post-hoc inference from webpage structures. Building on TSM, we propose MKD2World, a desktop web world model trained in two stages for current-state description and action-conditioned next-state prediction. During inference, the web agent queries MKD2World as needed and performs a ``digest'' step, in which it interprets each predicted state and extracts task-relevant evidence for selecting the best action. Experiments show that MKD2World-9B achieves an EleF1 score of 26.50 on the out-of-domain test set, outperforming GPT-5.6-Sol(14.98) by 11.52 points. Across Online-Mind2Web tasks, MKD2World-9B improves the success rate of the Qwen3.5-35B web agent from 22.94% to 37.61%, achieving competitive performance among leading open-source GUI world models. Code is available at https://github.com/OmniAI-Lab-CUHKSZ/MKD2World.

ai_summary.problem: 现有GUI智能体的世界模型状态表示无法同时刻画界面布局、UI语义与显式位置，导致预测出的动作后界面不够准确，限制了世界模型前瞻对决策的增益。
ai_summary.method: 提出类型化空间Markdown（TSM）表示，按空间关系序列化块级与原子级UI元素，联合编码类型、视觉语义、显式坐标、控件状态与层级归属；并通过在HTML注入元素类型标签后渲染直接抽取边界框，构建AtomBlock-WebUI数据集训练截图到TSM的渲染器；在此基础上构建MKD2World，分两阶段训练当前状态描述与动作条件下一状态预测，推理时智能体按需查询并做“digest”提取任务相关证据。
ai_summary.result: MKD2World-9B在域外测试集上EleF1达26.50，超过GPT-5.6-Sol的14.98达11.52分；在Online-Mind2Web上把Qwen3.5-35B智能体成功率从22.94%提升到37.61%，在开源GUI世界模型中具竞争力。
ai_summary.novelty: 用类型化、带显式空间坐标的Markdown文本统一表达界面结构与语义，并以可精确标注的数据构建动作条件世界模型，替代传统截图或HTML结构表示。
ai_summary.relevance: 为Web/GUI智能体提供了一种轻量、可解释且可精确监督的状态表示与世界模型范式，有助于提升智能体的前瞻规划与在线任务成功率。
ai_summary.org: 香港中文大学（深圳）OmniAI Lab（据代码仓库OmniAI-Lab-CUHKSZ推断）

papers.title: Spatially and Compositionally Controlled Multimodal Glioblastoma MRI Synthesis with Latent Diffusion
papers.abstract: Glioblastoma exhibits substantial heterogeneity in tumour morphology and composition across MRI modalities, often making available clinical datasets highly unbalanced in terms of patient pathologies. We propose a two-stage latent diffusion model (LDM) framework for the generation of explicitly controllable 2D glioblastoma MRI scans. First, a segmentation LDM generates tumour maps conditioned on location, spatial extent, axial position, and subregion composition. Second, a modality-conditioned LDM with ControlNet generates T1, T1Gd, T2, and FLAIR images adhering to the requested segmentation. On a held-out test set, generated segmentations achieved a mean centroid error of 0.842 pixels and a subregion proportion error of 0.795 percentage points. ControlNet improved Fréchet inception distance (FID) across all four modalities, reducing pooled FID from 42.59 to 36.12. An expert reader study yielded mean quality ratings of 6.60 for real images, 6.83 for ControlNet-generated images, and 6.77 for fully synthetic images.

ai_summary.problem: 临床胶质母细胞瘤MRI数据集在肿瘤形态、组成和模态上高度不平衡，难以生成空间与组成可控的多模态肿瘤影像。
ai_summary.method: 提出两阶段潜在扩散模型框架：先用分割LDM按位置、空间范围、轴位和子区域组成生成肿瘤分割图，再用模态条件LDM结合ControlNet生成符合该分割的T1、T1Gd、T2和FLAIR图像。
ai_summary.result: 生成分割的平均质心误差为0.842像素，子区域比例误差为0.795个百分点；ControlNet将四种模态的汇总FID从42.59降至36.12，专家评分显示合成图像质量接近真实图像。
ai_summary.novelty: 实现了对胶质母细胞瘤MRI空间位置、范围和子区域组成的显式可控多模态合成。
ai_summary.relevance: 为医学影像数据增强和可控多模态生成提供了可验证的扩散模型方案。
ai_summary.org: Stanford University

papers.title: $A^3$-VLA: Automatic Perception-Guided Attention Alignment for Robot Manipulation
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action Models (VLAs) enable robots to perform manipulation tasks by leveraging Vision-Language Models (VLMs) to process visual observations and language instructions. However, the action prediction objective itself lacks fine-grained task-specific perceptual supervision, making it prone to relying on task-irrelevant visual shortcuts, leading attention away from target objects and key interaction areas, thereby limiting its operational performance and generalization ability. To address this, we propose Automatic Perception-Guided Attention Alignment for Robot Manipulation ($A^3$-VLA), a framework that derives task-specific visual guidance from the manipulation process itself. Specifically, $A^3$-VLA first generates heuristic candidate regions for target objects and the robot from interaction-induced visual changes, and refines them with a visual segmentation model offline. These regions serve as explicit perceptual guidance through two complementary objectives: an attention allocation loss that encourages sufficient focus on task-critical regions when language or robot state tokens query the visual input, and a contrastive learning loss that aligns the representations of candidate target regions with language instructions while separating them from task-irrelevant regions. Extensive experiments on simulated and real-world manipulation tasks demonstrate that $A^3$-VLA consistently improves multiple VLA backbones, with an average success rate gain of 6.5% - 25.2% across benchmarks.

ai_summary.problem: 现有视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）的动作预测目标缺乏细粒度的任务相关感知监督，容易依赖与任务无关的视觉捷径，注意力偏离目标物体和关键交互区域，从而限制操作性能与泛化能力。
ai_summary.method: 提出 $A^3$-VLA 框架，从操作过程本身自动推导任务特定的视觉引导：先利用交互引起的视觉变化生成目标物体与机器人的启发式候选区域，再用视觉分割模型离线精修；随后通过两个互补目标施加监督——注意力分配损失（使语言或机器人状态 token 查询视觉输入时聚焦任务关键区域）与对比学习损失（对齐候选目标区域表征与语言指令、并推离无关区域）。
ai_summary.result: 在仿真与真实世界操作任务上，该方法可稳定提升多种 VLA 主干模型，各基准平均成功率提升 6.5%–25.2%。
ai_summary.novelty: 无需人工标注，从交互引发的视觉变化中自动挖掘任务特定的感知监督信号，并同时用注意力分配与对比学习两种目标显式对齐 VLA 的视觉注意力。
ai_summary.relevance: 为 VLA/具身智能提供了一种通用、即插即用的感知对齐训练范式，有助于提升机器人操作的鲁棒性与泛化性。

papers.title: DreamRealm: Exploring and Materializing Hallucination Worlds for Trustworthy Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) remain prone to visual hallucinations when correct responses depend on subtle visual details. One line of post-training methods constructs visual contrasts through image retrieval, generation, or editing to improve fine-grained perception. However, these contrasts are not built around the model's own hallucinations, making it difficult to ensure that supervision targets its actual perceptual confusions. Another line suppresses hallucinated outputs through response correction or preference learning under fixed image conditions, but leaves the design of supervision signals on the image-input side underexplored. Inspired by how humans correct misconceptions, we introduce DreamRealm, a post-training framework that explores diverse latent hallucinated responses, minimally edits original images to make them valid, and trains the model to assign each response to its supporting image. Our data construction pipeline, RealmForgePipe, mines observed and latent hallucinations from a target model and materializes them through image editing. Using hallucinations mined from Qwen3.5-9B, we construct the Realized Hallucination Dataset (RealmSet). Our training objective, RealmMatch, constructs a likelihood score matrix across image--response combinations and combines supervised learning with bidirectional contrastive losses to reinforce correct matches and suppress mismatches. Compared with the original Qwen3.5-9B model, DreamRealm improves performance across six visual perception and hallucination benchmarks, including gains of 7.26 percentage points in HallusionBench accuracy and 11.34 percentage points in MMVP pair accuracy. Together with ablation studies on data construction and training methods, these results demonstrate that hallucination assignment is a promising paradigm for improving visual perception and mitigating hallucinations.

ai_summary.problem: 多模态大模型在依赖细微视觉细节时仍容易产生视觉幻觉。现有方法要么构造的视觉对比并非围绕模型自身幻觉，要么主要在输出端纠正，图像输入侧的监督信号设计仍不足。
ai_summary.method: 论文提出 DreamRealm 后训练框架：先用 RealmForgePipe 从目标模型中挖掘已观察和潜在幻觉，并通过最小图像编辑将幻觉“实体化”，构建 RealmSet 数据集；再用 RealmMatch 在图像-回答组合上构建似然得分矩阵，结合监督学习和双向对比损失，强化正确匹配并抑制错误匹配。
ai_summary.result: 相比原始 Qwen3.5-9B，DreamRealm 在六个视觉感知与幻觉基准上均有提升，其中 HallusionBench 准确率提升 7.26 个百分点，MMVP pair 准确率提升 11.34 个百分点。消融实验也验证了数据构建和训练方法的有效性。
ai_summary.novelty: 核心创新是把目标模型自身的幻觉响应通过最小图像编辑变成“可支持的图像”，并将幻觉抑制转化为图像-响应匹配任务，配合双向对比学习进行监督。
ai_summary.relevance: 该工作为提升多模态大模型视觉感知可靠性和缓解幻觉提供了新的后训练范式，强调围绕模型自身感知混淆构造监督信号。

papers.title: VABAR: A Variational Automation Benchmark for Agentic Robotics
papers.abstract: For robots to operate reliably in commercial and industrial applications, they must persistently perform specific tasks with known variations in object shape and pose. We call this Variational Automation (VA) to differentiate these settings from fixed automation. Inspired by recent papers on Agentic Robotics, where pretrained LLM and VLM coding agents combine interpretable robot programming with the open-world adaptability of model free policies, we propose a general set of agentic robotics benchmark design criteria that includes accessibility, repeatability, diversity, relevance to agentic robotics and practical applications, physical realizability, resistance to benchmark saturation, and computational efficiency. We instantiate these principles in six manipulation task classes spanning industrial, medical, and infrastructure applications: tool sorting, tool hanging, gear meshing, syringe packing, cable insertion, and cable routing. We introduce the Variational Automation Benchmark for Agentic Robotics (VABAR), an open, easily replicable, simulation-based manipulation benchmark to systematically evaluating agentic robotics systems. Built fully on open-source tools, VABAR features detailed implementations using the Newton physics engine, standardized task variations, difficulty tiers, success metrics, and a library of 33 generalizable skills with human-authored programmatic reference solutions. We provide initial baseline evaluations using an open agentic manipulation harness, Graph-as-Policy (GaP), and Isaac Lab Arena.

ai_summary.problem: 商业和工业场景中的机器人需要在物体形状和位姿存在已知变化的情况下稳定地重复执行特定任务（即“变异性自动化”），但现有研究缺少一套系统化、可复现的基准，用来评估结合LLM/VLM编码智能体的机器人系统。
ai_summary.method: 论文提出了一套智能体机器人基准设计准则，包括可访问性、可复现性、多样性、与智能体机器人和实际应用的相关性、物理可实现性、抗基准饱和以及计算效率；并据此构建了VABAR仿真基准，覆盖工具分拣、工具悬挂、齿轮啮合、注射器装盒、线缆插入和线缆布线六类操作任务。该基准全部基于开源工具，采用Newton物理引擎，提供标准化任务变体、难度分级、成功指标、33个可泛化技能以及人工编写的程序化参考解。
ai_summary.result: 论文给出了使用Graph-as-Policy（GaP）智能体操作框架和Isaac Lab Arena的初步基线评估；但摘要中未报告具体性能数值，主要贡献是发布了一个开放、易复现的仿真评测平台。
ai_summary.novelty: 面向智能体机器人提出“变异性自动化”这一评测视角，并以系统化设计准则将工业、医疗和基础设施任务整合为统一的开源可复现基准。
ai_summary.relevance: 为LLM/VLM驱动的智能体机器人在真实工业级变异性操作中的能力评估提供了标准化测试平台，有助于推动智能体机器人从演示走向可靠部署。
ai_summary.org: 无法从提供的信息中确定（作者隶属机构字段为空）

papers.title: Benchmarking Fine-Grained Visual Reasoning for Remote Sensing in Urban Management
papers.abstract: Fine-grained visual reasoning is essential for remote sensing in urban management, yet remains underexplored in the evaluation of multimodal large language models (MLLMs). We introduce UMBench, a fine-grained urban remote sensing benchmark built from unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) images for multiple urban management tasks such as traffic monitoring, urban construction, environmental quality, and disaster warning. Evaluations on UMBench reveal that current MLLMs often rely on scene-level priors and overlook fine-grained visual evidence. To address this issue, we further propose a novel evidence-first chain-of-thought method that directs models to inspect fine-grained visual evidence in a training-free manner. Experiments show that our method can improve the performance of both open-source and commercial MLLMs on UMBench.

ai_summary.problem: 多模态大模型（MLLMs）在城市管理遥感场景下的细粒度视觉推理能力缺乏系统评测，现有模型往往依赖场景级先验而忽略细粒度视觉证据。
ai_summary.method: 构建了 UMBench——基于无人机（UAV）图像的细粒度城市遥感基准，覆盖交通监控、城市建设、环境质量、灾害预警等多类城市管理任务；并提出一种无需训练的“证据优先”思维链（evidence-first chain-of-thought）方法，引导模型先检查细粒度视觉证据再进行推理。
ai_summary.result: 评测显示当前开源与商用 MLLMs 在 UMBench 上普遍依赖场景先验、细粒度推理不足；所提证据优先思维链方法在无需训练的情况下同时提升了开源和商用 MLLMs 的性能。
ai_summary.novelty: 首次针对城市管理无人机遥感构建细粒度视觉推理基准，并提出免训练的证据优先思维链提示方法以纠正模型对场景先验的依赖。
ai_summary.relevance: 为多模态大模型在遥感与具身/城市智能等真实场景中的细粒度视觉推理能力提供了评测标准与轻量改进思路。

papers.title: Detecting Silent Action-Interface Mismatch with Calibrated Relational World Models
papers.abstract: A robot action can satisfy shape and range constraints yet carry the wrong semantics: axes may be permuted, signs inverted, rotations rescaled, or gripper polarity reversed. We study learned state-action-effect relations as offline contracts for detecting these mismatches and ranking their likely fields. Clean held-out transitions calibrate alarms; a fixed inverse vocabulary supports closed-set localization. On ten LIBERO Spatial tasks comprising 432 source episodes, a capacity-controlled comparison at 2.5% empirical clean false-positive rate gives 46.1% recall for a ridge forward residual, 61.0% for a four-component joint Gaussian mixture, and 65.7% for the exact conditional of that same mixture. The joint score retains a 14.9 percentage-point advantage over ridge, while conditioning improves recall by a further 4.7 points. Joint scoring instead has higher localization: 95.8% versus 94.6%. These matched-rate comparisons are retrospective diagnostics, not deployment calibration guarantees. Earlier Object/Goal results broaden tasks within the LIBERO convention; DROID, all three HYDRA tasks, short temporal faults, small offsets, exact repair, and simulated mitigation fail their respective gates, while xArm contributes one task only. The evidence supports a bounded offline diagnostic and a detection-localization tradeoff, rather than joint-density superiority or cross-robot safety.

ai_summary.problem: 机器人动作可能满足形状和范围约束但语义错误，例如轴置换、符号反转、旋转缩放或夹爪极性反转；论文研究如何离线检测这类动作-接口不匹配并定位可能的错误字段。
ai_summary.method: 将学习到的状态-动作-效果关系作为离线契约，用干净留出转移校准报警阈值；比较岭回归前向残差、四分量联合高斯混合模型及其精确条件密度，并用固定逆词表进行闭集定位。
ai_summary.result: 在LIBERO Spatial 10个任务、432个源episode上，以2.5%干净假阳性率为匹配条件，岭回归召回46.1%，联合GMM召回61.0%，条件密度召回65.7%；联合评分定位率95.8%略高于条件密度的94.6%，体现检测-定位权衡而非联合密度全面优越。
ai_summary.novelty: 把动作接口语义不匹配建模为可校准的关系世界模型离线契约，并系统量化检测与定位之间的权衡。
ai_summary.relevance: 为机器人学习中的动作语义安全诊断和世界模型离线验证提供了一种有边界、可复现的评估思路。
ai_summary.org: 提供信息未列出作者机构；Haixu Tang 通常隶属印第安纳大学伯明顿分校。

papers.title: AmbiHTMLBench: A Benchmark for HTML-based Visually Rich Document parsing
papers.abstract: Traditional document parsing systems use Markdown as their output representation, which is effective for linear text but does not fully preserve fine-grained spatial structure, table geometry, visual hierarchy, or rendering semantics. We show that HTML is advantageous for heterogeneous and layout-sensitive documents whose representations must remain editable, inspectable, and reusable, and introduce AmbiHTMLBench to systematically study this setting. In this benchmark, given a real-world document, a model must recover executable HTML that preserves its content, organization, and visual appearance. The benchmark contains 1,115 diverse pages with structured annotations and evaluates predictions in two different ways: The objective protocol aligns ground-truth and predicted rendered blocks and measures table fidelity, page-level text error, and a two-dimensional layout consistency; a complementary reference-anchored protocol measures perceived fidelity by aligning LLM judges with human preferences. Across ten primary multimodal systems, the best objective score is 0.8092, while the subjective winner is different, demonstrating that automatic decomposition and human-perceived fidelity capture complementary properties. We further fine-tune a small-parameter expert model and find that task-specific adaptation yields good performance on document-to-HTML reconstruction task. These results position AmbiHTMLBench as a diagnostic testbed for building smarter and more logical document parsing systems.

ai_summary.problem: 传统文档解析系统通常以 Markdown 作为输出表示，难以完整保留细粒度空间结构、表格几何、视觉层级与渲染语义；论文希望系统性地研究以 HTML 作为输出表示、面向异构且布局敏感文档的解析任务。
ai_summary.method: 论文构建了 AmbiHTMLBench 基准，包含 1,115 个多样化真实页面和结构化标注；要求模型根据输入文档恢复可执行 HTML，并采用两套协议评估：客观协议对齐真值与预测的渲染块，衡量表格保真度、页面级文字错误和二维布局一致性；参考锚定协议则通过使 LLM 评判与人类偏好对齐来衡量感知保真度。此外，论文还微调了一个小参数专家模型进行领域适配。
ai_summary.result: 在十个主流多模态系统上，客观指标最高分为 0.8092，但主观感知最优者与客观最优者并不一致，说明自动分解指标与人类感知保真度互补；微调后的小参数专家模型在文档到 HTML 重建任务上表现良好。
ai_summary.novelty: 论文以可执行 HTML 作为文档解析的输出与评测对象，并设计了客观渲染对齐与人类偏好锚定相结合的双协议评测基准。
ai_summary.relevance: 为多模态文档理解与解析系统提供了更具诊断性的测试平台，推动输出表示从 Markdown 走向保留布局与视觉语义的可编辑 HTML。

papers.title: Entropogram-guided Visual Realignment Decoding: Capturing the Rhythm of Multimodal Reasoning
papers.abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have demonstrated remarkable progress on cross-modal reasoning tasks, yet they continue to suffer from hallucinations in long-chain reasoning processes. In this work, we revisit hallucination in MLLMs from the perspective of reasoning generation dynamics. We argue that entropy is not merely a static measure of uncertainty but a structured signal that reflects how modality information is integrated throughout decoding. Through systematic analysis, we identify two characteristic entropy patterns associated with hallucination behaviors: (1) a generally high-confidence regime corresponds to premature convergence to inappropriate multimodal interactions; and (2) local abrupt entropy transitions are associated with reasoning instability and hallucination onset. Building on these observations, we propose an entropy-aware self-introspective framework for MLLM reasoning. Our method continuously tracks entropy dynamics during decoding and performs targeted visual re-alignment when suspicious hallucination states are detected, encouraging the model to re-examine salient visual evidence at critical reasoning stages. Extensive experiments across six multimodal reasoning benchmarks spanning nine distinct evaluation settings demonstrate that our approach delivers robust improvements in reasoning accuracy and hallucination robustness, while providing new insights into the generation dynamics underlying MLLM failures. The code is available at: https://github.com/jden4524/SelfRetrospectiveDecoding.

ai_summary.problem: 多模态大模型在长链跨模态推理中仍会产生幻觉，本文从解码过程中熵的动态变化角度重新审视幻觉的成因。
ai_summary.method: 作者系统分析解码期熵曲线，发现两类与幻觉相关的熵模式：整体高置信度导致过早收敛，局部熵突变预示推理不稳定；据此提出熵感知的自省式解码框架，持续监测熵动态，在检测到可疑幻觉状态时触发针对性的视觉重对齐，促使模型在关键推理阶段重新检查显著视觉证据。
ai_summary.result: 在六个多模态推理基准、九种评测设置下，方法在推理准确率和幻觉鲁棒性上均取得稳定提升，并为理解MLLM失败背后的生成动力学提供了新视角。
ai_summary.novelty: 将解码期熵视为反映模态信息整合过程的结构化信号，并用其引导按需的视觉重对齐，实现推理阶段的自我反思与纠错。
ai_summary.relevance: 为多模态大模型的幻觉抑制提供了无需额外训练的解码期干预思路，深化了对推理生成动力学的理解。

papers.title: Where It Breaks: Diagnosing Perception, Memory, and Decision Failures of a Vision-Language Agent in Pac-Man
papers.abstract: Training an agent to play Pac-Man with only up, down, left and right actions raises a basic question: when performance is poor, what should be improved? Difficulty can arise from reading the screen or from choosing actions over a long sequence. We examine these problems in a Qwen3.5-9B-based agent through separate perception checks and primitive-policy reinforcement-learning studies. In the policy study, which uses textual boards to remove image transcription from the decision interface, completion on eight held-out mazes increased from 0% before this optimization to 80.2% at a selected checkpoint, with three extra lives. The perception checks show that accurate static screenshot reading can coexist with errors during interaction. A separate policy comparison also shows that further optimization can accompany worse action choices. Together, these findings motivate concrete checks for post-training: evaluate perception in use, distinguish training success from full-game validation, and examine decisions and later performance rather than relying on one selected score. The study provides empirical lessons for improving future agent training and evaluation.

ai_summary.problem: 研究基于视觉语言模型的 Pac-Man Agent 表现不佳时，问题究竟出在感知、记忆还是决策环节，以及应如何诊断并改进训练与评估。
ai_summary.method: 使用基于 Qwen3.5-9B 的 Agent，分别进行感知检查和基于文本棋盘的原语策略强化学习；文本棋盘用于从决策接口中移除图像转写环节，从而分离感知与决策问题。
ai_summary.result: 在 8 个留出迷宫中，策略优化后完成率从 0% 提升到选定检查点的 80.2%（三条命）；静态截图读取准确并不代表交互中不出错，进一步优化也可能伴随更差的动作选择。
ai_summary.novelty: 通过分离感知检查与决策策略研究，揭示 VLM Agent 在交互中的感知、训练验证和决策评估脱节，并提出具体的 post-training 检查建议。
ai_summary.relevance: 为视觉语言 Agent 的训练与评估提供了可操作的诊断思路，强调应在实际使用中评估感知、区分训练成功与完整游戏验证，并关注决策及后续表现。

key_lab_papers.title: Traffic-VL: Reinforced Vision-Language Models for Generalizable End-to-End Traffic Signal Control
key_lab_papers.abstract: Existing traffic signal control methods typically rely on structured traffic states produced by dedicated perception pipelines. Emerging visual approaches often use idealized simulator images and convert them into intermediate representations before control, limiting their ability to directly exploit roadside visual observations. To bridge both the visual-domain and perception-to-decision gaps, we introduce SynTra-V and Traffic-VL. SynTra-V converts physics-based traffic simulations into photorealistic multi-view surveillance imagery across diverse road topologies and sensing conditions, and automatic semantic auditing checks that control-critical geometry, vehicle movements, and lane semantics match the simulator state. Traffic-VL is an eight-billion-parameter vision-language model that directly maps synchronized multi-view images and natural-language phase descriptions to signal decisions without intermediate structured states. Building on Traffic-R1's two-stage reinforced reasoning framework, Traffic-VL adapts its vision encoder via offline reinforcement learning on SynTra-V and freezes it during online visual stepwise trajectory policy optimization in closed-loop simulation. Experiments show that Traffic-VL matches structured-state Traffic-R1 while outperforming image-based controllers and general-purpose vision-language models, including Gemini 3 Pro. Evaluations on unseen topologies, degraded sensing conditions, real surveillance footage, and a three-week deployment across ten intersections further demonstrate robust visual generalization and effective constrained online control.

ai_summary.problem: 现有交通信号控制方法依赖专用感知流程生成的结构化交通状态，或使用理想化仿真图像并转为中间表示，难以直接利用真实路侧视觉观测，存在视觉域与感知到决策的鸿沟。
ai_summary.method: 论文提出 SynTra-V，将物理仿真转换为逼真多视角监控图像并进行自动语义审计；提出 8B 参数视觉语言模型 Traffic-VL，直接将同步多视角图像和自然语言相位描述映射为信号决策。方法基于 Traffic-R1 的两阶段强化推理框架，先在 SynTra-V 上离线强化学习适配视觉编码器，再在闭环仿真中冻结视觉编码器进行在线视觉逐步轨迹策略优化。
ai_summary.result: Traffic-VL 达到结构化状态 Traffic-R1 的水平，并优于基于图像的控制器和通用视觉语言模型（包括 Gemini 3 Pro）；在未见拓扑、退化感知条件、真实监控视频以及十个路口三周部署中表现出稳健的视觉泛化和受限在线控制效果。
ai_summary.novelty: 构建高保真多视角交通视觉数据与语义审计流程，并训练端到端强化视觉语言模型直接由路侧视觉观测和语言相位描述进行交通信号决策。
ai_summary.relevance: 展示了视觉语言模型在真实世界闭环决策与具身/城市智能系统中的潜力，推动了从感知到决策的端到端多模态控制研究。

key_lab_papers.title: MKD2World: A Typed Spatial MarkDown World Model For Web Agents
key_lab_papers.abstract: Graphical user interface (GUI) agents can improve decision-making with world-model foresight, provided that predicted states accurately reflect post-action interfaces. Existing state representations fail to jointly capture interface layout, UI semantics, and explicit locations. We introduce Typed Spatial Markdown (TSM), a Markdown-style textual state representation for desktop web interfaces. TSM serializes block-level and atomic-level UI elements according to their spatial relationships, jointly encoding their types, visual semantics, explicit locations, optional control states, and hierarchical membership. To train a screenshot-to-TSM renderer, we construct AtomBlock-WebUI, a dataset with precise annotations at both granularities. By injecting element-type labels into HTML and directly extracting bounding boxes after rendering, we avoid annotation errors caused by post-hoc inference from webpage structures. Building on TSM, we propose MKD2World, a desktop web world model trained in two stages for current-state description and action-conditioned next-state prediction. During inference, the web agent queries MKD2World as needed and performs a ``digest'' step, in which it interprets each predicted state and extracts task-relevant evidence for selecting the best action. Experiments show that MKD2World-9B achieves an EleF1 score of 26.50 on the out-of-domain test set, outperforming GPT-5.6-Sol(14.98) by 11.52 points. Across Online-Mind2Web tasks, MKD2World-9B improves the success rate of the Qwen3.5-35B web agent from 22.94% to 37.61%, achieving competitive performance among leading open-source GUI world models. Code is available at https://github.com/OmniAI-Lab-CUHKSZ/MKD2World.

ai_summary.problem: 现有GUI智能体的世界模型状态表示无法同时刻画界面布局、UI语义与显式位置，导致预测出的动作后界面不够准确，限制了世界模型前瞻对决策的增益。
ai_summary.method: 提出类型化空间Markdown（TSM）表示，按空间关系序列化块级与原子级UI元素，联合编码类型、视觉语义、显式坐标、控件状态与层级归属；并通过在HTML注入元素类型标签后渲染直接抽取边界框，构建AtomBlock-WebUI数据集训练截图到TSM的渲染器；在此基础上构建MKD2World，分两阶段训练当前状态描述与动作条件下一状态预测，推理时智能体按需查询并做“digest”提取任务相关证据。
ai_summary.result: MKD2World-9B在域外测试集上EleF1达26.50，超过GPT-5.6-Sol的14.98达11.52分；在Online-Mind2Web上把Qwen3.5-35B智能体成功率从22.94%提升到37.61%，在开源GUI世界模型中具竞争力。
ai_summary.novelty: 用类型化、带显式空间坐标的Markdown文本统一表达界面结构与语义，并以可精确标注的数据构建动作条件世界模型，替代传统截图或HTML结构表示。
ai_summary.relevance: 为Web/GUI智能体提供了一种轻量、可解释且可精确监督的状态表示与世界模型范式，有助于提升智能体的前瞻规划与在线任务成功率。
